LightningComponentBundle.description: Standalone, GraphQL-powered stand-in for the standard Lightning related list - drop it on a record page and point it at a child relationship. See relatedListReloaded/README.md.

property.name: relationshipApiName
property.label: Relationship API Name
property.description: The child relationship to show, exactly as configured in Setup - e.g. Contacts, Opportunities, or a custom relationship name ending in __r.

property.name: rowsWhenCollapsed
property.label: Rows Shown When Collapsed
property.description: How many rows to show before Expand is needed. Expanded view always shows up to 15 rows with pagination.
